design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to calcium supplementation or placebo using a computer-generated list of random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: A computer-generated random sequence was used with opaque envelopes to conceal allocation, and baseline characteristics were comparable across groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A computer-generated list of random numbers was used to allocate the corresponding treatments. Opaque envelopes with the bottles numbered were located at the clinic and the project coordinator was in charge of the administration of the treatment assigned.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blinding was effectively maintained with identical placebo tablets prepared by the hospital pharmacy, and analysis followed the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The placebo group received four tablets of the same weight, size, color, and organoleptic characteristics as the calcium tablets. All of the tablet containers were prepared at The Johns Hopkins Hospital Pharmacy. ... All subjects were included in the treatment group to which they were originally randomized regardless of any follow-up and treatment compliance experiences.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for 189 of 190 randomized participants (94 calcium, 95 placebo), representing negligible attrition (<1%).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Treatment consisted of 2.8 (±1.5) tablets per day in the placebo group (N = 95) and 3.0 (±1.4) tablets per day in the calcium group (N = 94)... All participants (including one dropout until the time she left the study) are included.

domain_judgments.rationale: Preterm delivery and gestational age were assessed objectively and attending obstetricians were blinded to treatment group assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Gestational age was calculated using the best obstetric estimation by the attending obstetrician who was totally unaware of the treatment groups. This evaluation was done at the time of randomization and was corroborated during pregnancy.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome was defined a priori with sample size calculation and analyzed according to a prespecified plan without evidence of selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The a priori hypothesis that calcium supplementation reduces the incidence of prematurity (<37 weeks) is tested. ... A sample size of 95 subjects in each group has a statistical power of 80% to detect a reduction in prematurity (<37 weeks) rates from 20% to 7% at an α-level of 0.05.

overall_summary: This double-blind randomized controlled trial employed appropriate sequence generation and allocation concealment, maintained blinding with an identical placebo, had virtually complete outcome follow-up, and used blinded, objective outcome assessment. All five RoB 2 domains are judged to be at low risk of bias.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated using a computer-generated list of random numbers to either calcium supplementation or matching placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Sequence generation was computer-generated and allocation concealment was ensured by having the list maintained by the pharmacy, with baseline characteristics well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After signing the consent form, patients were assigned using a computer-generated list of random numbers to receive either calcium supplementation of 2 g/day of elemental calcium (four tablets, each containing 1250 mg of calcium carbonate [Calcium Carbonate Tablets USP, Roxane Laboratories, Inc., Columbus, OH]) or matching placebo. The randomization list was maintained by pharmacy personnel; the drugs and placebo were delivered by the pharmacy to the antepartum ward, where nurses administered the medication.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind using matching placebo, all inpatients received consistent standard care, and all randomized participants were accounted for and analyzed according to their assigned groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The randomization list was maintained by pharmacy personnel; the drugs and placebo were delivered by the pharmacy to the antepartum ward, where nurses administered the medication. Clinicians caring for study patients were blinded to treatment group allocation.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were complete for all 75 randomized patients with no dropouts or missing data reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: During the study period, 75 eligible subjects were identified and invited to participate; 36 (48%) were assigned to calcium and 39 (52%) to placebo... Severe preeclampsia led to preterm delivery in 18 of 36 (50%, 95% CI 33–67) patients in the calcium group and in 19 of 39 (48.7%, 95% CI 32–65) in the placebo group

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessors and clinicians were blinded to allocation, and standardized clinical and laboratory diagnostic criteria were applied consistently across groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Clinicians caring for study patients were blinded to treatment group allocation... Diagnostic criteria and clinical management for severe preeclampsia were applied consistently.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the primary outcome and power analysis were specified a priori, no trial registry or published pre-specified statistical analysis plan is available, as is common for trials published in 1995.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The a priori hypothesis was that oral calcium supplementation would reduce the incidence of severe preeclampsia from 50% (based on our institutional experience) to 20%.

overall_summary: The trial was well conducted with sound randomization, blinding, and complete follow-up; however, overall risk is judged as some concerns due to the absence of a prospective trial registration or pre-published analysis protocol.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to either calcium supplementation or placebo using a computer-generated random number table.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although a computer-generated random number table was used, allocation concealment methods (e.g., sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes or central pharmacy allocation) are not explicitly reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The women were assigned randomly in a double blind fashion at 20 weeks' gestation to 1 of 2 treatment groups (calcium/placebo) using computer generated random number table.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind with identical placebo tablets and containers, making deviations from the intended intervention unlikely.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The placebo group received 4 tablets of the same size, weight and colour as the calcium tablets... All the containers and tablets used were specially prepared for the study by local Universal Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., Nagpur.

domain_judgments.rationale: Loss to follow-up was low (5.5%) and balanced between the treatment arms (5 vs 6), so missing outcome data is unlikely to have biased the results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eleven women (5.47%) were lost to follow-up after randomization (5 in the placebo group and 6 in the calcium group). Thus a total of 93 women in the placebo group and 97 in the calcium group were included in the final analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were objectively measured using standardized criteria and a random-zero sphygmomanometer with blinding maintained.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: At each visit blood pressure values were measured with patient seated after 10 minutes of rest by one physician (SD) specially trained and recruited for this study using random zero sphygmomanometer... Women were considered to have gestational hypertension if measurements of blood pressure on two occasions at least 6 hours apart revealed a systolic blood pressure >= 140 mmHg and a diastolic blood pressure >= 90 mmHg after the 20 weeks of gestation in the absence of proteinuria.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary prespecified endpoints (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, overall PIH) and standard maternal/neonatal outcomes were reported according to a clear analysis plan without evidence of selective outcome reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The main end point of the trial was the development of PIH. All randomized patients were included in the treatment group to which they had been originally assigned regardless of compliance or gestational age at delivery.

overall_summary: The trial was well conducted with double-blinding and low attrition, but details regarding allocation concealment were omitted, raising some concerns for Domain 1.

design_rationale: The study is described as a prospective, randomized, double-blind, controlled clinical trial in which participants were assigned to treatment regimens using a table of random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although a random number table was used to generate sequence and tablets were double-blind, the specific mechanism for allocation sequence concealment (e.g., sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes or central pharmacy allocation) is not explicitly described.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Using a table of random numbers each patient was assigned independently in sequence to one of two treatment regimens. Treatment assignment was double blind, with the composition of the tablets unknown to the patients and to all clinical personnel involved in the study.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was successfully double-blinded with identical placebos and no reported deviations from the intended protocol arose from the experimental context.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Treatment assignment was double blind, with the composition of the tablets unknown to the patients and to all clinical personnel involved in the study... The placebo group also received four tablets daily of the same size, weight, colour and organoleptic characteristics as the calcium tablets.

domain_judgments.rationale: Fourteen enrolled women (13.2%; 6/55 in the calcium group and 8/51 in the placebo group) were excluded post-randomization from the primary statistical analyses due to delivering before 38 weeks.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Only women with no missing values for any of the covariate and outcome variables were included in these statistical analyses, 49 in the calcium-supplemented group and 43 in the placebo group. Six women in the calcium-supplemented group and eight in the placebo group were eliminated from analysis because they were delivered before 38 weeks, although none was delivered before 36 weeks and none had any signs of PIH.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were measured using standardized clinical and laboratory methods by investigators blinded to treatment allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Treatment assignment was double blind, with the composition of the tablets unknown to the patients and to all clinical personnel involved in the study... All blood pressures were measured by the same investigator (M.N.) with a mercury sphygomanometer... The diagnosis of PIH was defined by a blood pressure of ≥ 140/90 mmHg or a rise of 30 mmHg in systolic or 15 mmHg in diastolic blood pressures from the baseline values observed at 24 weeks, on at least two occasions ≥ 6 h apart.

domain_judgments.rationale: The reported outcomes and statistical analyses closely align with all prespecified aims, methods, and measurement timepoints.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Differences between the supplemented and placebo groups in the occurrence of PIH were analysed statistically using a 2 × 2 contingency table analysis, with calculation of the χ2 statistic, using Yates' correction. Repeated measures analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) was the statistical method used to examine treatment group differences in systolic and diastolic blood pressure and serum ionized calcium over the course of gestation.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as 'some concerns' due to insufficient reporting of allocation concealment procedures (Domain 1) and the exclusion of 14 randomized participants (13.2%) who delivered before 38 weeks from the repeated measures analyses (Domain 3).

design_rationale: The study is a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial where participants were centrally randomized using variable blocks stratified by centre via telephone allocation.

domain_judgments.rationale: Central telephone randomization with variable block stratification and sealed treatment packs ensured adequate sequence generation and concealment of allocation, and baseline characteristics were balanced.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The randomization schedule was prepared by the drug company with stratification made by centre using variable blocks. When eligibility details were complete, a study number was given by the central randomization office. This corresponded to a sealed treatment pack held at the collaborating centre.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and care providers were blinded with identical-appearing tablets, standard care was provided to both groups, and an intention-to-treat analysis was performed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Each treatment pack contained identically labelled drug containers of either 600mg tablets of calcium or placebo tablets of lactose, identical in size, colour and consistency... All primary analyses were based on the treatment group allocated at randomization (intention-to-treat).

domain_judgments.rationale: Primary and secondary pregnancy outcome data were available for 100% of randomized participants.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Study outcome data were available for all 456 women and their babies.

domain_judgments.rationale: Objective diagnostic criteria were used, and outcome assessors and data analysts were blinded to treatment allocation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Delivery and postnatal care details were collected from case notes by the research assistants following hospital discharge and checked by a senior obstetrician, all blinded to treatment allocation. Data were entered and analysed by nonclinical members of the research team, and the treatment allocation code broken after exploratory data analyses.

domain_judgments.rationale: All prespecified primary and secondary outcomes were clearly defined and reported in accordance with the planned intention-to-treat analysis, and recruitment cessation was due to funding exhaustion without knowledge of outcome data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The prespecified primary endpoints were frequency of pregnancy-induced hypertension... frequency of preeclampsia... and frequency of preterm birth... Recruitment to the trial was stopped by the steering group without knowledge of study outcomes after 456 women were randomized when the limited financial resources available for the trial were exhausted.

overall_summary: The trial was a well-conducted double-blind randomized controlled trial with central allocation concealment, blinding of participants and outcome assessors, complete follow-up of all randomized participants, and reporting of all prespecified outcomes. All domains were judged to be at low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The study is a multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized controlled trial in which participants were randomly allocated using computer-generated random number blocking.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was computer-generated, concealed using consecutively numbered identical treatment boxes, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomization lists for each site were produced with computer-generated random number blocking (SAS Institute, Inc, Cary, NC) with randomly varying groups of 6 to 8 women and were used to restrict randomization within the strata (country). The technique consisted of allocating consecutively numbered treatment boxes for each woman. Randomization codes remained at the WHO Clinical Trial Unit until the time of analysis and were not available to any person until the analyses were completed.

domain_judgments.rationale: Both participants and personnel were blinded using identical placebo tablets, compliance was balanced and high, and an intention-to-treat approach was followed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The chewable tablets (Nycomed APS, Roskilde, Denmark) contained calcium carbonate or placebo (lactose, sorbitol, cellulose plus other calcium-free ingredients). They were identical in form, color, and taste. [...] Data from all subjects were included, irrespective of compliance or follow-up failures (intention-to-treat principle); women contributed with all available data until the time when they were lost to follow up.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for over 96% of participants with very low and balanced rates of loss to follow-up between study arms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Delivery information was unavailable for 143 women (3.4%) in the calcium group and 155 women (3.7%) in the placebo group; therefore, they did not contribute to the preterm analyses, but the available data were included in the analyses for other outcomes. Thus, 4151 women in the calcium group and 4161 women in the placebo group contributed to the final analyses (Figure 1).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were assessed using objective, standardized clinical definitions and procedures, and outcome assessors were blinded to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Midstream urine samples that were obtained at antenatal visits, on admission for labor, or before elective cesarean deliveries were screened for proteinuria, which was verified through urethral catheterization when membranes had ruptured. A WHO document was distributed to all clinical staf members who participated in the trial. [...] Routine antenatal care, which was standardized by the WHO Maternal and Perinatal Health Unit, followed local practice and assured standardized methods, main tenance of equipment, and quality control.

domain_judgments.rationale: Analyses and outcomes followed a prespecified trial protocol with all primary and secondary endpoints clearly reported according to the pre-established statistical plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All these outcomes were specified in the trial protocol. [...] All data analysis that were conducted (overall and stratified) followed the approved trial protocol, and all end points that were analyzed are reported. No additional exploratory analyses were conducted.

overall_summary: The study was a rigorously conducted, double-blind, multicenter randomized controlled trial with robust sequence generation, allocation concealment, low attrition, and prespecified analyses, yielding low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to receive calcium or placebo using a simple randomization sequence.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although allocation concealment was attempted through coded drug packets, the generation was a 'simple randomization sequence developed manually' without details on how the manual sequence was generated, and the numbers allocated (290 vs 262) suggest a modest imbalance from simple random assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The blinding of study participants and investigators was done by assigning coded numbers to the packets, each containing 60 tablets of calcium or placebo, according to a simple randomization sequence developed manually. The packets were then distributed to the participants using the random numbers in sequence.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and investigators were blinded with identical-appearing placebo and calcium tablets, and there is no evidence of deviations from intended interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Identical-looking tablets of calcium carbonate and placebo were prepared, each containing 500 mg of elemental calcium or lactose. The blinding of study participants and investigators was done by assigning coded numbers to the packets... The randomization code was disclosed after completion of the study.

domain_judgments.rationale: Attrition was very low (17/290 [5.9%] in the calcium group and 11/262 [4.2%] in the placebo group), balanced between groups, and unlikely to have biased the outcome estimates.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of the 552 women recruited for the study, 290 were randomly assigned to the calcium group and 262 to the placebo group. However, data regarding delivery and neonatal outcome could be obtained for 273 women in the calcium group and 251 women in the placebo group (Fig.1).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were assessed using standard objective criteria and protocols, and outcome assessors were blinded to intervention assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Blood pressure was measured at each visit using a manual mercury sphygmomanometer, with the participant sitting comfortably, as recommended by the British Hypertension Society and the Nurses Hypertension Association [13]... Pre-eclampsia was defined as a systolic blood pressure higher than 140 mm Hg and a diastolic blood pressure higher than 90 mm Hg on 2 occasions at least 4 hours apart after 20 weeks ofpregnancy in a woman with previously normal blood pressure, along with proteinuria...

domain_judgments.rationale: No clinical trial registration or pre-published statistical analysis plan was mentioned, leaving some concerns for selective reporting of results.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as 'some concerns' due to limited detail regarding the manual generation of the randomization sequence and the absence of a prospective trial registration or pre-published analysis protocol.

design_rationale: The authors conducted a double-blind, randomized controlled trial in which participants were assigned to calcium supplementation or placebo using a computerized random-sample generator.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated using a computer random-sample program and concealed using numbered, sealed, opaque envelopes, with balanced baseline characteristics between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: They were randomized at each hospital by a random-sample generator program provided by the Epistat Statistical Package. A complete set of numbered, sealed, opaque envelopes containing the randomization codes was sent to each of the three hospitals.

domain_judgments.rationale: Blinding was maintained with identical placebo tablets, no important deviations from the protocol were reported, and an intention-to-treat analysis principle was followed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Thus, the woman, the nurses, and the physicians responsible for prenatal care were all unaware of the woman's treatment status... All women were included in the treatment group to which they had been assigned, regardless of any problems that occurred during follow-up or as a consequence of noncompliance with treatment.

domain_judgments.rationale: Loss to follow-up was minimal (under 3% post-randomization excluded, and incomplete follow-up censored appropriately in survival analyses), balanced across arms, and results were shown to be robust when lost participants were included.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Twenty-seven women (2.3 percent) were lost to follow-up after randomization (13 in the placebo group and 14 in the calcium group) but before they started any treatment, and therefore were not included in the follow-up analyses. Follow-up was incomplete for 46 women in the placebo group and 52 women in the calcium group because of a change of hospital, physician, or residence. Nonetheless, all were included in the analyses up to the time when they were lost to follow-up.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessors were blinded to treatment allocation, objective standardized diagnostic criteria were used, and blood pressure was measured with calibrated random-zero sphygmomanometers.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Thus, the woman, the nurses, and the physicians responsible for prenatal care were all unaware of the woman's treatment status. The nurses and physicians were also responsible for distributing the bottles of medications, taking blood-pressure measurements, and collecting blood and urine samples... Blood pressures were measured with four random-zero sphygmomanometers rotated monthly among the centers and calibrated every three weeks.

domain_judgments.rationale: The prespecified primary outcome and hypotheses were evaluated according to standard, predefined statistical methods, with comprehensive reporting of all planned endpoints.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The main end point or dependent variable of the trial was the incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy... The a priori hypothesis was that calcium supplementation would reduce the incidence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy in the calcium group as compared with the placebo group.

overall_summary: The study was a rigorously conducted, double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial with central sequence generation, sealed opaque envelope concealment, minimal attrition, blinded objective outcome assessment, and clear adherence to prespecified analyses. All five RoB 2 domains were assessed as low risk of bias.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to calcium or placebo using a computer-generated simple randomization sequence.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated by computer, adequately concealed using identically appearing pre-numbered packages, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Packages of study tablets were prepared and numbered by the pharmaceutical manufacturer according to a computer-generated simple randomization sequence developed by the study statisticians. The packages were then shipped to the medical centers. On enrollment, each woman was assigned the next numbered package of medication at that center.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind with identical placebo tablets, no systematic deviations from protocol were reported, and an intention-to-treat analysis included all randomized participants.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The chewable study tablets, consisting largely of cornstarch and confectioner’s sugar, were packaged individually in blister packs... All the women randomly assigned to treatment were included in the primary analysis regardless of their follow-up status or compliance with treatment.

domain_judgments.rationale: Loss to follow-up was low (5.5%), balanced between study arms, and unlikely to bias the results of the primary outcomes.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Two hundred fifty-three women (5.5 percent) were lost to follow-up: 132 in the calcium group and 121 in the placebo group.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessors were blinded to treatment allocation, and preeclampsia and other outcomes were defined and measured using standardized objective criteria.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Surveillance for preeclampsia was conducted by personnel unaware of treatment-group assignments, using standardized measurements of blood pressure and urinary protein excretion at uniformly scheduled prenatal visits, protocols for monitoring these measurements during the hospitalization for delivery, and reviews of medical records of unscheduled outpatient visits and all hospitalizations.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial had a published protocol/design paper and reported all pre-specified outcomes and analyses according to the predefined plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A detailed description of the screening and selection procedures, including a complete list of exclusion criteria, has been published previously.21... All the women randomly assigned to treatment were included in the primary analysis regardless of their follow-up status or compliance with treatment.

overall_summary: This was a rigorously designed and conducted large-scale double-blind randomized controlled trial with central allocation concealment, blinding of participants and outcome assessors, low loss to follow-up, and an intention-to-treat analysis; all RoB 2 domains are judged as low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The authors state that participants were randomized to receive either elemental calcium or matching placebo by means of a computer-generated list.

domain_judgments.rationale: A computer-generated randomization list was used, tablets were dispensed in serially numbered computerized pill bottles by the hospital pharmacy ensuring allocation concealment, and baseline characteristics were comparable between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Women with positive angiotensin sensitivity tests were enrolled in the study and randomized by means of a computer-generated list (Systat 5.0; Systat Intelligent Software, Evanston, IL) to receive either 2 g/day of elemental calcium or matching placebo. Calcium and placebo tablets were provided by a pharmaceutical company... The tablets were dispensed by the hospital pharmacy in serially numbered computerized pill bottles so as to assess compliance.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind using identical placebo tablets, adherence was high and monitored electronically, and participants were analyzed according to their assigned groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The placebo tablets contained lactose and starch and were identical to the calcium tablets with respect to weight, size, flavor, and appearance... All randomized patients were included in the treatment group to which they had been originally assigned regardless of compliance.

domain_judgments.rationale: Four of 33 women assigned to the calcium group (12%) were lost to follow-up and excluded from the main analysis, and sensitivity analysis showed that under a worst-case scenario the statistical significance for preeclampsia is lost.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Four additional women, assigned to the calcium group, were completely lost to follow-up and could not be included in the follow-up analyses. Therefore, the results reported here are based on 29 women who received calcium and 34 women who received placebo.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were defined according to standard objective diagnostic criteria and evaluated by two perinatologists blinded to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Outcome data were collected after delivery but before the code was broken. The trial's main outcome variable was the frequency of pregnancy-induced hypertension. To determine and classify specific hypertensive disorders, all charts were reviewed by two perinatologists blinded to group allocation.

domain_judgments.rationale: The reported outcomes and planned analyses align with the pre-specified hypotheses and primary endpoints described in the protocol methods.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The trial's main outcome variable was the frequency of pregnancy-induced hypertension... Relative risks (RRs) and their 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated for the main outcome variables.

overall_summary: Overall risk of bias is rated as some concerns due to missing outcome data from four patients lost to follow-up exclusively in the intervention group (12% of the calcium group), which could potentially impact the statistical significance of the preeclampsia finding under a worst-case assumption. Other domains were adequately conducted with low risk of bias.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to receive either elemental calcium or placebo using a computer-generated random number table in blocks of ten.

domain_judgments.rationale: A computer-generated random sequence was generated, allocation was concealed via the investigational pharmacy preparing and dispensing identical containers/tablets, and baseline characteristics were comparable.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: At 28–31 weeks, study patients were assigned in a double-blind fashion to receive orally either 1.5 g elemental calcium as calcium carbonate or placebo daily, using a randomization schedule in blocks of ten developed by a computer-generated random number table (Excel version 6.0; Microsoft Corp., Seattle, WA). All containers and tablets were prepared and dispensed by the University of Washington Investigational Drug Pharmacy.

domain_judgments.rationale: Blinding of participants and personnel was maintained with matching placebos, but noncompliant subjects and those developing medical complications (5 of 23 participants, disproportionately in the placebo group: 4 placebo vs 1 calcium) were excluded from analysis rather than analyzed by intention-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The placebo tablets were of the same size, weight, color, and organoleptic characteristics as the calcium tablets... Noncompliance was defined as missing 2 consecutive days of prescribed study drug or having a total of 2 days' worth of study pills remaining at the time of pill counts, and noncompliant subjects were excluded from analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Nearly 22% of randomized participants (5 of 23; 4 of 11 placebo vs 1 of 12 calcium) had missing outcome data at 6 weeks with imbalances in reasons between groups, which could introduce bias given the very small sample size.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Twenty-three women were randomized, and 18 of them completed the study. Of the five who failed to complete the study, three developed preterm labor and were treated with terbutaline (all placebo), one was noncompliant (placebo), and one self-discontinued study medication due to side effects (calcium).

domain_judgments.rationale: Objective measurement methods (automated blood pressure cuff and Doppler cardiac output monitor) were used under standardized conditions, and double-blinding minimized risk of bias in outcome assessment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Blood pressure and hemodynamic measurements were performed in the left lateral recumbent position after 5 minutes of rest. Blood pressure was measured in the left arm by automated cuff (Accutor; Datascope, Paramus, NJ)... Cardiac output was measured by Doppler technique using the UltraCOM Cardiac Output Monitor (Lawrence Medical, Redmond, WA)... All containers and tablets were prepared and dispensed by the University of Washington Investigational Drug Pharmacy. The placebo tablets were of the same size, weight, color, and organoleptic characteristics as the calcium tablets.

domain_judgments.rationale: No trial pre-registration or published statistical analysis plan was mentioned to confirm that all prespecified analyses and hemodynamic outcomes were reported without selection.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Changes in hemodynamic measurements were analyzed by analysis of variance for repeated measures, and comparisons were made within groups to assess for changes over time and between groups to assess for changes due to study medication.

overall_summary: The study is judged to have some concerns overall due to post-randomization exclusions/attrition (22% dropouts, imbalanced across arms) without an intention-to-treat analysis, along with the absence of a pre-registered trial protocol.
